article.title: Bulldozers, glyphosate, white phosphorus: Israel’s destruction of South Lebanon’s olive groves
article.author: Vanessa Kallas
article.content: Lebanese farmers are losing their livelihood as Israeli forces uproot centuries-old trees, destroy olive groves, and demolish entire towns and villages, rendering them uninhabitable.
